normative_atomic_binder_audit.typeclass_expansion: NormedAddCommGroup and InnerProductSpace provide the compatible additive, metric/norm and real inner-product structures. CompleteSpace is completeness of that induced uniform space, not finite dimensionality or boundedness. Project-owned bundles are expanded separately below.

RegularLoss: ConvexOn Real U f (includes convexity of U)
expanded_project_context.project: Classical choice from actual proved nearest-point existence. project_existsUnique and project_spec characterize membership and attainment of the real infimum indexed over subtype V.carrier; no default/fallback.
expanded_project_context.step: project V (x - eta smul gradient f x)
expanded_project_context.iterate: index 0 = x0; index t+1 = step V eta (loss t) (iterate V eta loss x0 t)
expanded_project_context.regret: sum over Finset.range T of loss t (iterate V eta loss x0 t) - loss t u

entries.name: BanditRL.OnlineHuber.huber_regret_fixed

theorem huber_regret_fixed (delta Z eta : ℝ) (hd : 0 ≤ delta)
    (hZ : 0 ≤ Z) (heta : 0 < eta) (z : ℕ → E) (y : ℕ → ℝ)
    (x0 u : E) (T : ℕ) (hz : ∀ t < T, ‖z t‖ ≤ Z) :
    regret fullSpace eta (fun t => linearLoss delta (z t) (y t)) x0 u T ≤
      ‖x0 - u‖ ^ 2 / (2 * eta) + eta / 2 * ((T : ℝ) * (delta * Z) ^ 2) -
      ‖iterate fullSpace eta (fun t => linearLoss delta (z t) (y t)) x0 T - u‖ ^ 2 /
        (2 * eta)
